_: English overlay for puzzle content. Keys are the Spanish strings exactly as they appear in groups.json / expansion.groups.json; look-ups fall back to the key when a string is missing, so a new group is never a crash, just untranslated. Card names stay Spanish on purpose: the name is printed on the card art. Rhyme and letter explanations are copied verbatim because the wordplay is Spanish; hidden-word explanations carry an English gloss in parentheses.
